style.backgroundSystem: airy light-blue diamond-lattice pattern #C9E4F4 for mood screens, crisp white #FFFFFF info screens, rose-pink #F2A7BC over light-blue color-block geometric panels for benefit screens, smooth light-grey concrete #EDEAE6 for lifestyle and macro shots
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons, small airflow bubble accents, small mint-teal numbered circles; none on packshots and macros
style.lightingSystem: bright soft high-key studio light, front-left key with soft fill, soft contact shadows, clean controlled highlights; lifestyle shots use diffused natural daylight with realistic soft shadows
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh summer youth womens-sneaker ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of crisp white #FFFFFF, airy light-blue #C9E4F4, warm concrete grey #EDEAE6, rose-pink accent #E86C8C and a mint-teal secondary accent #4CB8A8 reserved for small highlight chips; cool tone; modern geometric sans-serif headlines only; consistent thin outlined rounded-rectangle tag labels; consistent thin-line icon style; clean bright product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and placement with balanced natural margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for pairs, single-shoe tilted side view for floating shots, consistent product scale across the set, thin single-layer profile always clearly visible
style.surfaceSystem: smooth light-grey concrete floor #EDEAE6, matte white studio sweep, pale-blue painted wall #C9E4F4
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines only; mint-teal #4CB8A8 solid headline chips and thin outlined rounded-rectangle tag labels
